_notChunked.description: private field to keep track whether to avoid using chunked Transfer-Encoding for the {@link HttpRequest}

_headers.description: The internally used case-insensitive HTTP headers.

url.description:
The URL to send the request.
Always required.

encodedBody.description: The encoded body as either binary or {@Link ByteStream} for the request.

connection.description: The connection for which this request was instantiated.

title:
All C3 remote requests go over HTTP. The only thing we add is connection from which the request was initiated since
different connections to different servers may have different metadata and even different implementations.
name: ServerRequest
